The situation south of Rome showing German prepared defensive lines

In early October 1943, Hitler was persuaded by his Army Group Commander in Southern Italy, [Field Marshal](/wiki/Generalfeldmarschall "Generalfeldmarschall") [Albert Kesselring](/wiki/Albert_Kesselring "Albert Kesselring"), that the defence of Italy should be conducted as far away from Germany as possible. This would make the most of the natural defensive geography of [Central Italy](/wiki/Central_Italy "Central Italy"), whilst denying the Allies the easy capture of a succession of airfields, each one being ever closer to Germany. Hitler was also convinced that yielding southern Italy would provide the Allies with a springboard for an invasion of the Balkans, with its vital resources of oil, bauxite, and copper.[[52]](#cite_note-FOOTNOTEOrgill19675-65)

Kesselring was given command of the whole of Italy and immediately ordered the preparation of a series of defensive lines across Italy, south of [Rome](/wiki/Rome "Rome"). Two lines, the [Volturno](/wiki/Volturno_Line "Volturno Line") and the [Barbara](/wiki/Barbara_Line "Barbara Line"), were used to delay the Allied advance so as to buy time to prepare the most formidable defensive positions, which formed the *[Winter Line](/wiki/Winter_Line "Winter Line")* – the collective name for the Gustav Line and two associated defensive lines on the west of the Apennine Mountains, the [Bernhardt](/

Facilities include a children's water park, a full-size basketball court, an ice-skating rink, a zip line that is 10 decks high, a 1,400-seat theater, an outdoor aquatic theater with Olympic-height platforms, and two 43-foot (13 m) rock-climbing walls.[[14]](#cite_note-14)[[15]](#cite_note-15)[[16]](#cite_note-16)[[17]](#cite_note-17)[[18]](#cite_note-18) There is also a park containing over 20,000 tropical plants.[[12]](#cite_note-springer-12)

*Symphony of the Seas* is powered onboard by six marine-diesel sets composed of three 16-cylinder [Wärtsilä](/wiki/W%C3%A4rtsil%C3%A4 "Wärtsilä") 16V46D [common rail](/wiki/Common_rail "Common rail") engines and three [12-cylinder](/wiki/V12_engine "V12 engine") Wärtsilä 12V46D engines.[[19]](#cite_note-:3-19)

The [energy-efficient](/wiki/Energy_efficiency_(physics) "Energy efficiency (physics)") design of *Symphony of the Seas* requires less shipboard power generation, with 85 MW versus the 100 MW normally found on *Oasis*-class ships.[[20]](#cite_note-:2-20) One of the key design features is the use of only [LED](/wiki/LED "LED") or [fluorescent lights](/wiki/Fluorescent_light "Fluorescent light") in order to avoid the heat generation from [incandescent bulbs](/wiki/Incandescent_bulb "Incandescent bulb"), thereby reducing the load on air conditioning systems.[[20]](#cite_note-:2-20) Additional energy efficiency is accomplished by using a 2 MW steam turbine to recover waste heat from the engines and converting it into energy to power a portion of the onboard hotel load.[[21]](#cite_note-:0-21)

For propulsion, *Symphony of the Seas* uses three 20 MW [azipod](/wiki/Azipod "Azipod") main engines, which are electric thrusters. These engines are mounted under the stern of the ship and they each drive 6.1-metre (20 ft)-wide rotatable propellers. In addition to the three main engines, there are four bow thrusters used for docking, each with 5.5 MW of power

**Saudi Arabia**,[[d]](#cite_note-18) officially the **Kingdom of Saudi Arabia** (**KSA**),[[e]](#cite_note-19) is a country in [West Asia](/wiki/West_Asia "West Asia"). Located in the centre of the [Middle East](/wiki/Middle_East "Middle East"), it covers the bulk of the [Arabian Peninsula](/wiki/Arabian_Peninsula "Arabian Peninsula") and has a land area of about 2,150,000 km2 (830,000 sq mi), making it the [fifth-largest country](/wiki/List_of_Asian_countries_by_area "List of Asian countries by area") in [Asia](/wiki/Asia "Asia"), the largest in the Middle East, and the [twelfth-largest](/wiki/List_of_countries_and_dependencies_by_area "List of countries and dependencies by area") in the world. It is bordered by the [Red Sea](/wiki/Red_Sea "Red Sea") to the west; [Jordan](/wiki/Jordan "Jordan"), [Iraq](/wiki/Iraq "Iraq"), and [Kuwait](/wiki/Kuwait "Kuwait") to the north; the [Persian Gulf](/wiki/Persian_Gulf "Persian Gulf"), [Bahrain](/wiki/Bahrain "Bahrain"), [Qatar](/wiki/Qatar "Qatar") and the [United Arab Emirates](/wiki/United_Arab_Emirates "United Arab Emirates") to the east; [Oman](/wiki/Oman "Oman") to the southeast; and [Yemen](/wiki/Yemen "Yemen") to [the south](/wiki/Saudi_Arabia%E2%80%93Yemen_border "Saudi Arabia–Yemen border"). The [Gulf of Aqaba](/wiki/Gulf_of_Aqaba "Gulf of Aqaba") in the northwest separates Saudi Arabia from [Egypt](/wiki/Egypt "Egypt") and [Israel](/wiki/Israel "Israel").[[15]](#cite_note-20)[[16]](#cite_note-21) Saudi Arabia is the only country with a coastline along both the [Red Sea](/wiki/Red_Sea "Red Sea") and the [Arabian Gulf](/wiki/Arabian_Gulf "Arabian Gulf"), and most of its terrain consists of arid desert, lowland, steppe, and mountains. The capital and largest city is [Riyadh](/wiki/Riyadh "Riyadh"); other major cities include [Jeddah](/wiki/Jeddah "Jeddah") and the two holiest cities in [Islam](/wiki/Islam "Islam"), [Mecca](/wiki/Mecca "Mecca") and [Medina](/wiki/Medina "Medina").

Therefore, Asia is a region where various independent cultures coexist rather than sharing a single culture, and its boundary with Europe is somewhat arbitrary and has moved since its first conception in [classical antiquity](/wiki/Classical_antiquity "Classical antiquity"). The division of Eurasia into two continents reflects [East–West](/wiki/East%E2%80%93West_dichotomy "East–West dichotomy") cultural differences, some of which vary on a spectrum.

"[Me at the zoo](/wiki/Me_at_the_zoo "Me at the zoo")", the first video on YouTube, was uploaded by Karim on April 23, 2005.

[![](//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/7/72/Jawed_Karim_2004.jpg/250px-Jawed_Karim_2004.jpg)](/wiki/File:Jawed_Karim_2004.jpg)

Karim in September 2004

In university, Karim served an Internship at [Silicon Graphics](/wiki/Silicon_Graphics "Silicon Graphics"), Inc., where he worked on 3D voxel data management for very large data sets for [volume rendering](/wiki/Volume_rendering "Volume rendering"), including the data for the [Visible Human Project](/wiki/Visible_Human_Project "Visible Human Project").[[13]](#cite_note-14) While working at PayPal in 2002, he met [Chad Hurley](/wiki/Chad_Hurley "Chad Hurley") and [Steve Chen](/wiki/Steve_Chen_(YouTube) "Steve Chen (YouTube)"). Three years later, in 2005, they founded the video-sharing website YouTube.[[14]](#cite_note-usatoday-nov-21-2005-15) Karim created the first account on YouTube, "jawed", on April 23, 2005 [PDT](/wiki/PST_Time_Zone "PST Time Zone") (April 24, 2005 [UTC](/wiki/UTC "UTC")),[[15]](#cite_note-16) and uploaded the website's first video, "[Me at the zoo](/wiki/Me_at_the_zoo "Me at the zoo")", the same day.[[16]](#cite_note-CNN-17)[[17]](#cite_note-MeAtTheZoo-18)

After co-founding the company and developing the YouTube concept and website with [Chad Hurley](/wiki/Chad_Hurley "Chad Hurley") and [Steve Chen](/wiki/Steve_Chen "Steve Chen"), Karim enrolled as a graduate student in computer science at Stanford University while acting as an adviser to YouTube. When the site was founded in February 2005, Karim agreed not to be an employee and simply be an informal adviser, and that he was focusing on his studies.

The first episode, "[Rollercoaster](/wiki/Rollercoaster_(Phineas_and_Ferb) "Rollercoaster (Phineas and Ferb)")", garnered a total of 10.8 million viewers when aired as a preview on August 17, 2007, holding onto more than half of the record-setting audience of its lead-in, *[High School Musical 2](/wiki/High_School_Musical_2 "High School Musical 2")*.[[59]](#cite_note-HM2-62) When *Phineas and Ferb* officially debuted in February the next year, it proved to be cable's number-one watched animated series premiere by [tweens](/wiki/Preadolescence "Preadolescence"). Throughout the quarter that followed, it peaked as the top-rated animated series for ages 6–10 and 9–14, also becoming the number-three animated series on cable television for viewers aged 6–10.[[30]](#cite_note-DCrenews-33) By the time the second season was announced in May 2008, the series had become a top-rated program in the 6–11 and 9–14 age groups.[[60]](#cite_note-SF-63)

The Disney Channel airing of "[Phineas and Ferb Get Busted!](/wiki/Phineas_and_Ferb_Get_Busted! "Phineas and Ferb Get Busted!")" was watched by 3.7 million viewers.[[61]](#cite_note-64) The episodes "Perry Lays an Egg" and "Gaming the System" achieved the most views by ages 6–11 and 9–14 of any channel in that night's time slot. This achievement made the series the number-one animated telecast that week for its target demographics.[[62]](#cite_note-TBN_ratings-65) On June 7, 2009, Disney announced that the show had become the number-one primetime animated show for the 6–10 and 9–14 groups.[[9]](#cite_note-QA-12)

The premiere of "[Phineas and Ferb Christmas Vacation](/wiki/Phineas_and_Ferb_Christmas_Vacation "Phineas and Ferb Christmas Vacation")" garnered 2.62 million viewers during its debut on Disney XD, the most watched telecast in the channel's history (including [Toon Disney](/wiki/Toon_Disney "Toon Disney")) and the number-three program of the night across all demographics.
